thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: SRE oncall — elevated 5xx and token latency in us-west-2a affecting inference paths. Pagerduty alert PD#98765. Root cause guess: instance network packet loss / rx-queue spikes.

sam-sre: seeing ~4.8% 5xx across inference-router pool in us-west-2a. latency p95 for generate up from 220ms -> 1.9s. customers A/B/C reporting timeouts.

alex-infra: +1. I can see a subset of G5 instances showing NIC errors in cloud console, TX/RX errors increasing. ENI detach counts spiked ~00:08UTC.

maria-support: support queue: 12 SEV2 tickets opened, mostly 502/504 from Redwood API, some with full logs showing `socket hang up`. Customers on Dedicated seats more impacted.

sam-sre: kick off mitigation runbook: 1) shift traffic away from us-west-2a to us-west-2b for non-customer-isolated routes, 2) drain bad nodes, 3) scale spare capacity in us-west-2b, 4) notify customers.

alex-infra: running quick health check: `aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters Name=availability-zone,Values=us-west-2a Name=status,Values=in-use` -> anomalous RX errors on eni-0aabcd.

infra-bot: Action logged: created reroute-ticket RT-3921 to move inference-router targets off us-west-2a.

sam-sre: @alex-infra please: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment router-usw2b --replicas=6` and run `rtrctl reroute --from us-west-2a --to us-west-2b --exclude-dedicated` (exclude dedicated until we confirm data-plane isolation).

alex-infra: running commands now. patching autoscaler to allow +50% burst in us-west-2b.

alex-infra: patched. router-usw2b replicas scaled to 6. Starting gradual reroute, 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 12m windows.

sam-sre: starting first 10% step. watch metrics: error-rate, kv-cache hit ratio, tokens/sec. If kv-cache regen causes spike, we may need staged warming.

maria-support: drafting customer note for impacted Dedicated: "We're seeing increased errors and latencies in us-west-2a. We're routing traffic away and will follow up with ETA. For Dedicated customers: data plane isolation preserved — we'll coordinate if you see anomalies."

leo-product: question: any risk of model load failures when we increase cross-AZ traffic? we have pinned versions in Dedicated clusters.

sam-sre: Risk low for pinned Dedicated. For hosted routes we may need to fallback to smaller-quant models if capacity tight. Will monitor OOM/load errors.

infra-bot: Health-check summary (00:12 UTC): us-west-2a router pool errors 5.1% -> after 30% reroute 2.3%, p95 latency reduced from 1.9s -> 1.1s.

alex-infra: noticed one AZ host with kernel networking logs: `NETDEV WATCHDOG: eth0: transmit queue 0 timed out`. filing cloud provider ticket with instance IDs.

sam-sre: good catch. Please tag instances `incident=4923456789` and `do_not_reuse`. We'll drain and replace.

alex-infra: tagged and beginning `kubectl drain node/gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

maria-support: customer comms updated and sent to the impacted tenant list. initial blurb: "We're actively rerouting traffic. Some requests may see degraded latency or errors for up to 15–30 minutes." :email:

sam-sre: oncall handoff plan: @oncall-rotations will take the incident if it persists beyond 20m. For now I'm staying until steady state.

oncall-rotations: acknowledged, watching on-call channel.

infra-bot: Cloud ticket opened: CT-5532 (provider investigating NIC hardware/flapping in us-west-2a).

sam-sre: quick customer impact tally: - Hosted API: increased 5xx peaked at 6%, now 1.2% post-reroute. - Dedicated: isolated, 2 tenants reported slow tail latencies likely due to cross-AZ failover (warmup/kv-cache misses). - Embeddings pipeline saw p99 spikes ~4s for 10–15 minutes.

leo-product: flagged on the status page: put a banner on status.redwood.ai "Intermittent degraded performance in us-west-2a, mitigation in progress".

maria-support: customers asking about data loss: confirm no data loss — only transient errors.

sam-sre: confirm: no persisted job failure or model corruption seen. All writes to durable stores OK.

alex-infra: drained 3 suspect nodes, replacing with fresh instances. Reprovisioning autoscaling group with new launch template that disables problematic ENI offload feature.

infra-bot: Replacement instances launched: i-0fabc123, i-0fabc124.

sam-sre: metrics look stable after full reroute and replacements: error-rate back to baseline 0.3%, p95 generate ~210ms. continuing 1h watch.

oncall-rotations: taking over monitoring, will escalate if errors >1% sustained for 15m.

maria-support: sending follow-up email to impacted customers with post-incident summary and remediation steps.

sam-sre: postmortem owners: infra (alex-infra) + networking + SRE. Tentative timeline meeting 2pm UTC tomorrow. Assigning postmortem ticket PM-4923.

leo-product: any followups to reduce blast radius? suggestion: pre-warm spare cross-AZ KV caches after a cross-region reroute script.

sam-sre: noted. We'll include cache-warm and smarter staged reroute in postmortem actions.

incident-bot: Incident state changed to: monitoring. Incident link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-98765

sam-sre: closing thread here — handoff to @oncall-rotations for monitoring. Thanks all :thumbsup:

oncall-rotations: acknowledged, will post an update if anything changes.
